title: The Big Egg
summary: 孵蛋+找妈妈:公园发现大蛋孵出小恐龙找妈妈,恐龙妈妈出现,小恐龙跑向妈妈。
text: {{name}} is at the park. {{name}} sees a big egg. It is white and big. What is in the egg? Is it a bird? No. Is it a duck? No. The egg opens! A baby dinosaur looks out. It is little and green. The baby looks at {{name}}. "Mom? Mom?" it says. "No, no! I am not a mom!" A big dinosaur comes. She is very big! The baby runs to her. "Bye, little dinosaur!" says {{name}}.

questions.prompt: What does {{name}} see at the park?
